frequency_question: What proportion of major federal voting-related bills pass the U.S. Senate within an approximate one-year legislative window?
membership_rule: Includes major standalone bills specifically targeting federal voter registration requirements, voter ID, or election administration originating or considered in the Senate since 1994. Excludes routine appropriations or omnibus packages.

cases.name: FOR THE PEOPLE / FREEDOM TO VOTE Act attempts (2021-2022)
American Confidence in Elections (ACE) Act attempts (2023-2024)

coverage_note: 5 major legislative pushes named; represents the universe of comparable standalone or flagship federal voting eligibility/reform pushes in the modern Senate era.
known_gaps: Minor technical amendments are excluded; only major partisan or bipartisan structural voting bills are counted.
validity_reason: The procedural hurdle of the Senate filibuster and typical polarization regarding election laws remain stable structural features of the institution for the foreseeable future.
